requirements.text: Personalised timetable management must allow students to colour-code modules
Personalised timetable management must allow students to hide cancelled classes
Personalised timetable management must allow students to add personal study blocks
Timetable management interface must be intuitive and easy to access
Automated grade notifications must be delivered via push notifications in the portal
Automated grade notifications must be delivered via email
Automated grade notifications should offer optional SMS alerts
Students must be able to configure their preferences for notification frequency
Structured module feedback system must have a straightforward online submission form
Feedback submission must ensure anonymity of students
Feedback must be aggregated and anonymised before being shared with module coordinators
Feedback should only be available to module coordinators after grades have been submitted
Ensure compliance with GDPR and the university's data retention policy
All new features must integrate seamlessly with the existing portal’s authentication system
No changes should be required to the existing student records database schema
